profile.description: Current 2026 event verified from the Bear Lake County Chamber. Bear Lake Harvest Festival is Sept. 19, 2026 from 12:00 PM-6:00 PM at the Bear Lake County Fairgrounds in Montpelier, Idaho. The Chamber describes it as an annual fall tradition featuring local growers, makers and food artisans. Standard vendor applications are open through Aug. 31, 2026, but the published form is designed around 10x10 booth spaces, so Adventure Zone should contact the Chamber directly before applying to discuss a substantially larger staffed attraction footprint. This is a separate event/profile from the historical Bear Lake Fall Market Days lead in Garden City, Utah unless an organizer later confirms a relationship.
